title: CSS, Notification by @Jakubantalik: Tip for notification badge appear animation to make it feel more natur
notes:
Tip for notification badge appear animation to make it feel more natural: • For the scale transition, adjust the origin point to the bottom left • Use a subtle bounce on the scale transition • Animate the position as well

Designer: @Jakubantalik. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
